original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-fully-faithful}
Let $A$ be Noetherian ring complete with respect to an ideal $I$.
Let $f : X \to \Spec(A)$ be a proper morphism. Let
$\mathcal{I} = I\mathcal{O}_X$.
Then the functor (\ref{equation-completion-functor}) is fully faithful.
stage_a_standalone_statement_draft:
Notation: for a Noetherian scheme $X$ and quasi-coherent ideal sheaf $\mathcal I\subset\mathcal O_X$, $\textit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ is the category of inverse systems $(\mathcal E_n)_{n\geq1}$ of coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules satisfying $\mathcal I^n\mathcal E_n=0$ and $\mathcal E_{n+1}/\mathcal I^n\mathcal E_{n+1}\cong\mathcal E_n$ via the transition maps; morphisms are compatible maps of systems. For any coherent $\mathcal E$, put $\mathcal E^\wedge=(\mathcal E/\mathcal I^n\mathcal E)_{n\geq1}$.
Let $A$ be Noetherian ring complete with respect to an ideal $I$.
Let $f : X \to \Spec(A)$ be a proper morphism. Let
$\mathcal{I} = I\mathcal{O}_X$.
Then the functor $\textit{Coh}(\mathcal{O}_X)\longrightarrow\textit{Coh}(X,\mathcal{I}),\quad \mathcal{G}\longmapsto (\mathcal{G}/\mathcal{I}^n\mathcal{G})_{n\geq 1}$ is fully faithful.
stage_b_review_note: Preserves full faithfulness (not essential surjectivity) of completion Coh(O_X)→Coh(X,I) for proper X over a Noetherian I-complete ring A and I=I·O_X.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-existence-projective}
Let $A$ be Noetherian ring complete with respect to an ideal $I$.
Let $f : X \to \Spec(A)$ be a projective morphism. Let
$\mathcal{I} = I\mathcal{O}_X$.
Then the functor (\ref{equation-completion-functor}) is an equivalence.
